data.long_meaning: Kaneezan is an Arabic name that means 'treasured possession' or 'precious gem'. It symbolizes the value and importance of a child in the eyes of their parents. The name Kaneezan carries the meaning “Treasured Possession” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kaneezan usually hope their child will grow to embody treasured possession and live with faith, good character and purpose.
